theme_strategy: Light and Dark Mode Toggle - Focus on High Contrast Swiss styling for clarity in a bustling repair shop environment.

colors.primary_description: International Klein Blue - for primary actions (Save, Submit, New Ticket)
colors.surface: Flat solid surfaces with 1px border. No glassmorphism in main dashboard to prevent visual refraction of data.

typography.strategy: Soft Utility mixed with Swiss clarity
rules: Overlines and Labels must be uppercase, tiny, wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).
Jump between headings must not exceed 2 Tailwind steps.

grid_rules: Grid items MUST be direct children.

surfaces_and_components.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border (border-border), no shadow. Hover: Slight lift (-translate-y-1), subtle shadow.
surfaces_and_components.buttons: Sharp or slightly rounded (rounded-md), solid colors. NO generic pill buttons unless specified. Micro-animations on hover.
surfaces_and_components.tables: Shadcn UI tables, dense padding, hover states on rows. Status badges using distinct high-contrast colors.
surfaces_and_components.forms: Shadcn UI forms. Left-align inputs and labels.
surfaces_and_components.navigation: Sidebar with Lucide icons. Must include Logo, Navigation Links, User Profile, Theme Toggle, and Logout.

rules: Hover states on all interactive elements.
Transition specific properties (transition-colors, transition-transform) - NEVER transition-all.

images.description: Technician working on smartphone repair under microscope
Detailed close-up of a circuit board

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building 'Aplikasi Servis HP- Klinik Kana', a dashboard for a phone repair shop.
Install and use 'lucide-react' for all icons.
Install and use 'recharts' for the revenue and status distribution charts.
Implement a sidebar navigation (Dashboard, Customers, Repairs, Spare Parts, Users, Reports).
Create a robust RBAC login UI (Admin, Technician, Cashier).
Use Shadcn UI components for Tables, Dialogs, Select, Forms.
Use Sonner for toast notifications (e.g., when a repair ticket is created).
Add a WhatsApp notification simulation button on the Repair Detail page (using wa.me link).
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.
Avoid generic centered layouts. Use left-aligned dense data presentation.
Ensure the layout is fully responsive.
Generate styles specifically for .js/.jsx ecosystem without Typescript specific type annotations when setting up components.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic AI slop aesthetics.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, but keep dashboard surfaces flat and readable.
NEVER center align the app container.
Do not use placeholder text for missing images. Use the provided image URLs.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, focus states).
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical for main sections to give breathing room, but keep grids dense.
